AuthorizedUser.title: AuthorizedUser
AuthorizedUser.description: A Google account allowlisted by the Admin to access NIWAS Tasklet.

email.description: Lowercase Google or Google Workspace email address.

name.description: Display name of the authorized user.

addedBy.description: Email of the admin who added this user.

UserPreference.title: UserPreference
UserPreference.description: Per-user supervisor assignment and remembered default tasklet visibility.

email.description: Lowercase email of the user owning this preference.

supervisorEmail.description: Email of the assigned supervisor (or null if none).

supervisorName.description: Display name of the assigned supervisor (or null if none).

defaultListScope.description: Remembered list scope radio filter (Show all, Show supervisor, Show mine).

SequenceCounter.title: SequenceCounter
SequenceCounter.description: Atomic global sequence counter for unique tasklet numbers.

Tasklet.title: Tasklet
Tasklet.description: A deadline-tracked tasklet item with creator/supervisor visibility and terminal state locking.

seq.description: Globally unique sequential numeric tasklet identifier.

deadlineISO.description: Mandatory future deadline timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Progress or resolution notes (3-50 words required before closing/abandoning).

resolvedAtISO.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when closed or abandoned, or null if active.

createdBy.description: Display name of the user who created the tasklet.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

visibility.description: Whether the tasklet is shared with the tagged supervisor or private to creator.

supervisorEmail.description: Email of the tagged supervisor if visibility is supervisor, or null.

supervisorName.description: Display name of the tagged supervisor if visibility is supervisor, or null.

/authorized_users/{userEmail}.description: Allowlisted Google accounts permitted to sign into NIWAS Tasklet and be selected as supervisors.

/user_preferences/{userEmail}.description: Per-user supervisor assignment and remembered default visibility.

/counters/{counterId}.description: Atomic global sequence counter for unique tasklet numbers.

/tasklets/{taskletId}.description: Workspace tasklets visible only to creator and tagged supervisor.
